summary: 靖康后于南京即位，建炎播迁、定都临安延宋祚；绍兴和议杀岳飞，为千古讥议。
summary_en: Ascending at Yingtian after the Jingkang disaster, he weathered the Jianyan flight and fixed the capital at Lin'an to prolong the dynasty, but the Shaoxing Treaty and Yue Fei's execution drew eternal censure.

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary_en: Ninth son of Huizong, enfeoffed Prince Kang.

timeline.title: 即位南京
timeline.summary: 靖康后于南京应天府即位，改元建炎，南宋始。
timeline.summary_en: He ascended at Yingtian after the Jingkang disaster, era Jianyan; Southern Song began.

timeline.title: 苗刘之变与航海
timeline.summary: 苗傅刘正彦之变逼帝退位旋复，金兵南下帝航海避敌。
timeline.summary_en: The Miao-Liu mutiny briefly forced him off the throne, and he fled by sea when Jin troops advanced.

timeline.title: 定都临安
timeline.summary: 以临安为行在，驻跸东南，江南立国局面定。
timeline.summary_en: He made Lin'an the temporary residence and settled in the southeast, fixing the southern state.

timeline.title: 绍兴和议与杀岳飞
timeline.summary: 与金和议称臣划淮，岳飞下狱遇害；为后世争议焦点。
timeline.summary_en: The treaty with Jin made Song a vassal along the Huai River, and Yue Fei was imprisoned and killed, a lasting controversy.

timeline.title: 内禅
timeline.summary_en: He abdicated to Xiaozong and became retired emperor.

timeline.title: 太上皇崩
timeline.summary_en: Died at the Deshou Palace in Lin'an.

timeline.title: 高宗总评
timeline.summary: 能延宋祚于东南，而和议杀飞，功罪俱见。
timeline.summary_en: He preserved the dynasty in the southeast, yet the peace treaty and Yue Fei's death show both his achievement and his shame.

bio_md:
# 宋高宗 · 主要事迹

赵构为[[n-song-hui|徽宗]]第九子，封康王。靖康二年（1127）二帝北掳后，即位于南京应天府（今商丘），改元建炎，是为南宋之始。

建炎年间高宗一度流徙海上：苗傅、刘正彦之变逼其退位旋复；金兵南下，高宗航海避敌，漂荡于浙东沿海。绍兴八年（1138）定行在临安（今杭州），驻跸东南，江南立国之局始定。绍兴十年（1140）岳飞等北伐连捷，郾城大捷后高宗却以「十二道金牌」召回诸将，绍兴十一年（1141）与金订「绍兴和议」：称臣划淮，岁贡银绢各二十五万，岳飞下狱遇害。和议换得宋金二十年相安，然「莫须有」之狱为千古之憾。

绍兴三十二年（1162）高宗内禅，养子赵眘即位，是为[[s-song-xiao|孝宗]]；高宗称太上皇二十五年，淳熙十四年（1187）崩。

bio_parts_en.value:
, held the title Prince Kang. After the two emperors were taken north in 1127 he was enthroned at Yingtian (modern Shangqiu), era Jianyan - the founding of Southern Song.

The Jianyan years were a desperate flight. The Miao-Liu mutiny forced his temporary abdication; when Jin troops advanced he fled to sea, drifting along the Zhejiang coast. In 1138 he fixed the temporary capital at Lin'an (modern Hangzhou), settling the southern state. In 1140 Yue Fei and others won victories at Yingchang and Yancheng - until Gaozong recalled the armies with "twelve gold edicts." In 1141 the Shaoxing Treaty made Song a vassal along the Huai River with annual tribute; Yue Fei was imprisoned and executed. The treaty brought twenty years of peace, but the "trumped-up charge" remains an eternal grievance.

In 1162 Gaozong abdicated to his adopted son Zhao Shen,
, and reigned on as retired emperor for twenty-five years, dying in 1187.
